title: Residue-triple colimits as strict henselizations of prime localizations
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $p\in\operatorname{Spec}R$, and $K$ a separable closure of the scheme residue field $\kappa(p)$ [def-weil-residue-field]. Let $c$ be a universal cocone of the diagram of etale residue triples over $(R,p,K)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-residue-triples]. Let $C$ be a commutative ring, $e:c.\mathrm{pt}\cong C$ a ring isomorphism and $b:R\to C$ a homomorphism such that for every triple $t$, the composite $R\xrightarrow{t.\alpha}t.B\to c.\mathrm{pt}\xrightarrow{e}C$ equals $b$. Put $A=R_p$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. There exist a field $L$ which is a separable closure of the residue field of $A$, compatible residue-field and $A$-algebra structures on $L$, and an $A$-algebra structure on $C$ such that $R\to A\to C$ equals $b$ and $C$ is an algebraic strict henselization of $A$ relative to $L$ [def-sc-ring-strict-henselization].

proof.text: Present the prime localization as the filtered colimit of principal localizations outside p. Descent of finitely presented etale objects, their morphisms and equalities shows that passing from R-triples to local-base triples preserves the colimit. The pointed principal localizations supply the inverses of elements outside p.

Identify the residue field of R_p with kappa(p) and transport the separable closure through this canonical field isomorphism. Extend the R-map uniquely to R_p. Compare the local-base residue triples with pointed etale algebras using the kernel prime and the residue embedding. The given colimit is a strict henselization in that presentation.
Transport its local-base algebra structure and universal cocone through e. The hypothesis on all legs identifies its composite R-map with b.

theorem etaleResidueTriples_localized_isStrictHenselization
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (p : Spec R)
    (K : Type u) [Field K]
    [Algebra ((Spec R).residueField p) K] [IsSepClosure ((Spec R).residueField p) K]
    (c : Cocone (etaleResidueTriplesRingDiagram R p K
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap ((Spec R).residueField p) K))))
    (hc : IsColimit c) (C : CommRingCat.{u}) (e : c.pt ≅ C) (b : R ⟶ C)
    (hbase : ∀ t, t.α ≫ c.ι.app t ≫ e.hom = b) :
    ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L)
      (_ : Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)) L)
      (_ : IsSepClosure (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)) L)
      (_ : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) L)
      (_ : IsScalarTower (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)
        (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)) L)
      (_ : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) C),
      (∀ r : R, algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) C
        (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) r) = b.hom r) ∧
      Algebra.IsStrictHenselization (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) L C
